faqs.a:
Subject to the payment provisions herein expressly provided, the bonds, any interest
               coupons thereto attached and any temporary bonds shall be fully negotiable within
               the meaning of and for all the purposes of the Uniform Commercial Code—Investment
               Securities.
(Code 1981, § 27-84; Ord. No. 551, § 29(F), 5-14-1964; Ord. No. 636, § 3, 9-6-1966)
State Law reference—
Uniform Commercial Code, Investment Securities, C.R.S. § 4-8-101 et seq.; bonds negotiable,
               C.R.S. § 31-25-535.
